summary: Iteration 7 — Store-readiness verification for Expo/React Native app at /app/rosslending-app/ after metadata-only edits to app.json (removed unused Android permissions RECORD_AUDIO + ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION; removed unused iOS NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription + NSFaceIDUsageDescription; tightened remaining iOS usage strings; added NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription + Android READ_MEDIA_IMAGES). NO REGRESSIONS DETECTED. (1) JSON validity: app.json parses cleanly via python json.load — name='Ross House', android.permissions=['CAMERA','READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE','READ_MEDIA_IMAGES']. (2) Code-vs-permission audit: grep across app/ and src/ for expo-location, Location., expo-av, expo-audio, LocalAuthentication, FaceID, RECORD_AUDIO → ZERO matches, confirming the removed permissions/usage strings were truly unused in code (safe to drop, store-reject avoided). (3) ImagePicker (camera+library) is referenced in 7 screens (scan-bill.tsx, maintenance/new.tsx, chat.tsx, admin-create-expense.tsx, admin-inspection-detail.tsx, edit-profile.tsx, PhotoPicker.tsx) — kept NSCameraUsageDescription/NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription/CAMERA/READ_MEDIA_IMAGES match actual usage. (4) Expo web preview at http://localhost:3000 bundles successfully (1505 modules, ~16s) and renders: splash/onboarding screen ('Bienvenido a Ross House Rentals'), /(auth)/login screen (phone+SMS, 'Iniciar con Email', ES/EN toggle), and /market tab (Mercado header, search, popular cities Dumas/Amarillo/Dallas/Houston/Austin, bottom tabs Inicio/Propiedades/Mercado/Perfil). NO red-screen errors, NO permission-related console messages, NO PAGEERROR events. Only pre-existing benign warnings: expo-notifications web compat, shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation (unrelated to app.json edits). The app is functionally unaffected by the store-readiness cleanup — ready for store submission from a permissions/metadata standpoint.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor reports 15 packages out of sync with installed expo@54.0.34 (expected 54.0.35). Notable mismatches: expo-image-picker@55.0.20 (expected ~17.0.11), expo-local-authentication@55.0.13 (expected ~17.0.8), expo-device@55.0.16 (expected ~8.0.10), @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0). These are NOT blockers for the current store-readiness edit but should be aligned with `npx expo install --check` before the EAS build to avoid runtime surprises. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log + package.json.

Package expo-local-authentication is still in /app/rosslending-app/package.json but FaceID/biometric prompt is never called anywhere in app/ or src/ (grep returned 0 matches). Either wire up a biometric login flow OR remove the dependency to shrink the bundle and avoid Apple reviewers questioning unused biometric capability. Reference: package.json + app.json (NSFaceIDUsageDescription was already removed correctly).

Many components use deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props (RN web emits warnings on every render). Migrate to style.boxShadow/textShadow and style.pointerEvents to clean up the console. Not a store blocker but polish. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Run `npx expo install --check` inside /app/rosslending-app to align 15 packages with expo@54.0.34's expected versions before the next EAS build.
OPTIONAL — Remove `expo-local-authentication` from package.json since no biometric flow exists in code (matches the FaceID usage string already removed from app.json).
OPTIONAL — Migrate deprecated style props (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) to their modern equivalents to silence RN web warnings.
NO ACTION REQUIRED for the actual store-readiness edits — app.json is valid, no regressions in app load/login/marketplace, no permission-related console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json:21 — buildNumber is hardcoded to '1' and android.versionCode is 1. For store submissions you'll need to bump these per upload (Apple/Google reject duplicate build numbers). Consider using EAS auto-increment in eas.json (`autoIncrement: 'buildNumber'`/`'versionCode'`).

app.json:30-38 — NSExceptionDomains allows insecure HTTP loads for photos.listhub.net and listhub.net (IDX/MLS image CDN). App Store reviewers occasionally ask for justification of NSAllowsArbitraryLoads exceptions; ensure the App Privacy questionnaire mentions third-party IDX feed.
app.json:8 — `scheme: 'rossrentals'` is set but verify the same scheme is registered in any OAuth/Stripe Connect redirect URIs (otherwise deep links from external providers will fail post-publish).
package.json — expo-local-authentication is installed but never imported (no FaceID/biometric flow); dead dependency.
